name: .NET / ASP.NET Core SignalR + React + Redis
description: Realtime web stack: ASP.NET Core (.NET 10) minimal API with cookie auth, bounded algorithm workbench and an authorized SignalR hub implemented and tested (backend unit+integration incl. hub over TestServer; web unit+build). Redis is declared as an optional SignalR backplane but unverified (no Redis server); docker-compose is declarative only (no Docker daemon).
